## Summary

**Problem:** `checkout-api` was failing health checks after the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions, with an elevated error rate of 0.18.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Investigated** — `get_service_status` confirmed v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Deployment history showed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back** to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The first attempt partially completed (us-east) and halted on an orchestrator error, so I retried and the rollback fully completed — all three regions are now on v2.3.0.
3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** — `INC-0001` ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy") was created and is open, describing the failure and the rollback. (The initial call timed out, but the incident was confirmed created via `list_incidents`.)

**Final state:** `checkout-api` is on v2.3.0 in all regions, healthy, with error rate back down to 0.002.
